facts.fact: The article says the New Deal technologique was 'launched' (lancé) in February 2025 to accelerate the country's digital transformation; it names no adopting act or body.
The programme comprises 12 programmes and 50 priority projects for an announced FCFA 1,105 billion (about US$2 billion) over 2025-2034, per the article.

Prime Minister Ahmadou Al Aminou Lo's general policy statement of 8 September 2026 placed a sovereign cloud and sectoral AI use at the centre of the New Deal and narrowed project selection to what is feasible, financed and measurable.

note: The document does not describe the strategy's scope beyond digital transformation and the policy statement's priorities, so class is left empty. Stated period 2025-2034, no text linked, so no period fact. The 12 programmes and 50 projects are the strategy's own, with an announced total.
